message:
We've all had those moments where we realize we’re just not quite ready for the unexpected. Like that time we found ourselves without candles during a power outage, or when we thought a ‘snack’ was enough for a road trip. 🤦‍♂️

Being prepared doesn’t have to be a daunting task! It can be a fun opportunity to gather supplies we might actually use, all while sharing some laughs together. Let’s take a look at some useful tips that can help us build our own kit, so we’re ready for whatever life throws our way.

After all, a little preparation can go a long way—who knew gathering snacks could be so enlightening? 😄
